title: fix(ui): start the GPU layer playback from the Simulate view (S3c)
body:
This PR is slice S3c of the GPU stock sim (#2629), for #3336. It does not close #3336. Read "Not exercised" first: no hardware adapter was available.

## What changed

- The Simulate view starts the playback worker in the layer mode of PR #3882 when two things are true. The window shell made a cutter on the render device. The stock eye has a GPU trace pass.
- In each other case the CPU playback of before starts. Nothing changes for these users.
- New module `crates/ui/src/play_layer.rs`:
  - `render_cutter` makes the cutter. It runs `cut_onto_or_cpu_on` (the S2 and S3a kernel) on the render device of the window. It makes no second device (#3589).
  - A software adapter (`DeviceType::Cpu`) gets no cutter. `CAMCRAFT_GPU_COMPUTE=off` gives no cutter. A device without compute gives no cutter. One log line names the reason.
  - The kernel is compiled on the playback worker at the first batch, not on the UI thread.
  - `cut_input` maps `TwinItem` to `CutItem` field by field.
- The view pass (`view_pass.rs`) tells the state if the eye traces on the GPU. If the eye holds a layer frame but marches it on the CPU, the layer playback ends and the CPU playback starts. The status line says this one time.
- `PlayWorker::spawn_layered_precalc` (app): the layer mode with the calculation before playback (#2181).
- `FieldPlay::set_layer` (app) keeps the layer mode off when no operation has an f32 twin.
- The bench `stock_play_cost_bench.rs` gets a layer-mode walk (`playback_cost_in_the_layer_mode`, ignored, release).
- Decision record: `docs/decisions/3336-gpu-layer-playback.md`.

## Cause

- PR #3878 and PR #3882 added the kernel and the layer mode. No caller turned the mode on. `crates/ui/src/actions.rs` called `PlayWorker::spawn_precalc` only.
- `set_layer` left the layer mode on with zero layer operations. Each frame was then a whole-layer pack (11.2 ms on fig8) in place of a patch (0.13 ms).

## Finding: the reference programs of #3336 do not reach the GPU

- The fig8 2D Offset and the 3D Pocket each have arc moves. The f32 twin refuses an operation with an arc (`an arc move has no twin; only linear moves cut here`). The operation stays on the f64 field.
- Reading (release, this branch, Linux, one run): fig8 15.6 ms for each move, Pocket 5.3 ms for each move. These are the values of the reading of 2026-11-22.
- Arcs on the kernel are slice S4 (#2628). This PR gives a gain only for a program whose operations have linear moves only, with a ball or flat end mill, on a hardware adapter.

## Tests

Pins (each failed before the fix):

- `play_layer_tests::the_transport_starts_the_layer_playback_when_the_eye_traces_on_the_gpu`
- `play_layer_tests::a_still_frame_of_the_layer_playback_cuts_nothing_again` (the counter test of #3336 on the layer path)
- `play_layer_tests::an_eye_that_cannot_hold_the_layer_frame_ends_the_layer_playback`
- `play_layer_tests::an_eye_that_does_not_trace_on_the_gpu_keeps_the_cpu_playback` (the CPU fallback test of #3336)
- `play_layer_tests::the_layer_playback_ends_only_for_a_held_frame_off_the_gpu`
- `play_layer_tests::a_twin_item_maps_to_the_kernel_item_field_by_field`
- `play_layer_tests::a_software_adapter_gets_no_kernel_by_name`
- `stock_play_picture::the_layer_playback_with_the_calculation_before_playback_draws_the_field_picture`
- `stock_play_picture::a_program_with_no_twin_op_keeps_the_layer_mode_off`
- `play_layer_gpu::the_gpu_cutter_draws_the_cpu_twin_layer_and_a_device_without_compute_takes_the_cpu_law` (ran on llvmpipe; the kernel answered, `CutPath::Gpu`; 7 seek positions within the twin margin; a device without compute gave the CPU layer)

Red before the fix:

- Without the start in `follow_playhead`: the first three pins failed (`the worker runs in the layer mode`, `the layer playback cut up to the playhead`, `assertion failed: state.layer_play.on`).

Mutations:

- `start_cutter` without the `eye` and `refused` conditions: 3 pins red (`an_eye_that_does_not_trace_on_the_gpu_keeps_the_cpu_playback`, `an_eye_that_cannot_hold_the_layer_frame_ends_the_layer_playback`, `the_layer_playback_ends_only_for_a_held_frame_off_the_gpu`). Restored: green.
- `set_layer` without the no-twin condition: `a_program_with_no_twin_op_keeps_the_layer_mode_off` red. Restored: green.

Original gate results on the final head `3aebb3a38`, base `upstream/main` d80dc6944:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 30 steps, 0 failed; 2,154 passed, 15 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: 69 steps, 1 failed. The failure is `pocket3d_hsm` `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`: `the mesh behind the Linux path pin`, 5232 against 6228 facets. It fails at the model import, before a toolpath or a playback. `pocket3d_hsm` is red on main (#3886). This PR changes no import and no toolpath code.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog`: 43 passed, 4 ignored.

## Goldens moved

None. `example_catalog` ran green and `git status` showed no changed file. The PR changes display playback only. It changes no toolpath, no post and no verdict code.

## Review evidence for PR #4001

`play_layer_gpu.rs` is the only new top-level test binary. It needs its own process to keep one test and one graphics device alive (#3589, #3605). This device isolation avoids two live devices in one process.

### Before and after screenshots

- Before: runtime source from `upstream/main` `d80dc6944f912171a06029f635e0450c505d44a9`. ![Simulate before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/359114e474e4d01f3e4c79a8dfe5feff19ef3690/pr-4001/simulate-before.png)
- After: PR head `3aebb3a38500aae1c2356c11e0fc21b13eb78b04`. ![Simulate after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/359114e474e4d01f3e4c79a8dfe5feff19ef3690/pr-4001/simulate-after.png)
- Scene: a 12 x 12 x 20 mm stock with a staged Face1 operation and a 4 mm flat end mill. The playhead is paused at 14.2815 of 23.8025 seconds (60%). The camera and layout are identical. Both captures produced the same pixels; the CPU fallback picture stays unchanged.
- Actual render adapter in both captures: `llvmpipe (LLVM 19.1.7, 256 bits)` via Vulkan, software. CPU playback cuts the stock in both captures. The stock composite is ready before each capture.

The screenshots use the same Simulate scene and seek position. They render the shipping shell layout and the shipping viewport pass with the stock composite. They use an offscreen capture harness. They do not show a native window or prove the hardware GPU layer path.

### Checks repeated on 2026-11-25

The code head is unchanged: `3aebb3a38500aae1c2356c11e0fc21b13eb78b04`. The base is current `upstream/main` `d80dc6944f912171a06029f635e0450c505d44a9`.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 30 steps, 0 failed; 2,154 passed, 15 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: 69 steps, 68 OK, 1 unexpected failure, 0 stalled (44.5 minutes). The failure is `pocket3d_hsm::the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`: the import facet pin reads 5232 against 6228. This is the same failure reported in the original body (#3886).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog`: 43 passed, 4 ignored. No golden or catalog file changed.

### Evidence checks

These two review findings require PR text and screenshot evidence. They require no production code changes. A code pin and a code mutation do not apply. The PR text check fails when these sections are removed and passes when they are restored.

## Not exercised

- No hardware adapter. This machine has llvmpipe only. The kernel on the render device of a real window did not run. The frame rate with the GPU cutter is not measured. The parity on a hardware adapter (#2629, precondition 1) is not proven; the layer is display only.
- The window shell path (`shell_window.rs` to `shell_cutter`) and the view pass rule did not run in a window. The rule itself (`LayerPlayback::must_end`) and `play_layer::end` are pinned without a window.
- A second thread that polls the render device while the UI thread draws did not run.
- No path choice by batch size (#2629, precondition 3). Only the adapter type decides.
- The browser shell gets no cutter. The wasm build was not run.
- The screenshots above show the software adapter path. No hardware adapter was available to show the GPU layer playback.
- If a layer worker runs with zero layer operations and the eye falls to the CPU march, the playback restarts one time without need. The picture stays correct.

## Overlaps

- PR #3963 changes `crates/ui/src/state.rs` in a different function. This PR adds one field to `State`. Whichever merges second refreshes.

Changelog: Simulate: the stock playback cuts operations that have linear moves only (ball or flat end mill) with the GPU kernel on the window's graphics device, when it is a hardware adapter; the CPU playback runs in each other case.
